## Caveats

- PROSPECT is part of AlphaPeptDeep's training corpus and its train/val partition is not ours, so held-out-for-us peptides may be trained-on-for-the-teacher. These are optimistic ceilings, not held-out measurements.
- The teacher is queried with per-row collision energy but a fixed Lumos instrument; per-row detector and fragmentation are not passed through.
- irt_affine_residual_mae is the residual around the best affine fit because the teacher's RT head has its own scale; raw MAE would not be comparable.

## By acquisition

peptdeep conditions only on charge, NCE and one instrument one-hot, so neither the
analyzer nor the activation type is expressible to it. Label state is read from the
modifications, and crossed with acquisition so the two penalties can be separated.
